summary: The pickup step of a shipment: where/when the load is collected. Required.
range: Object: { id (req), location_index (req), service?, time_windows?, setup?, sequence_order?, max_visit_lateness? }.
businessRules: Served by the same vehicle as its delivery, and BEFORE the delivery step (C4).
pickup defines: Specify the details of the pickup step of the shipment.
Must stay consistent with: shipments.delivery, shipments.pickup.location_index. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Required field. Missing causes HTTP 400 validation error.
testingGuidance: Positive: pickup with a valid location_index and window.
Infeasible: pickup window strictly after the delivery window -> pair unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: delivery time window earlier than the pickup window -> precedence infeasible -> both unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: two amount [3] shipments onboard together on capacity [5] -> one deferred by capacity.
Interaction: Precedence: pickup [10:00,11:00], delivery [09:00,09:30] (delivery before pickup) -> both unassigned.
